description: Variant of PC3288R. This course is enhanced with the Research Experience Programme, where students attend seminars and workshops, access writing consultations, receive a grant to do independent research, and present their findings at a conference. Please note that only 4 Units can be accredited towards major or specialisation requirements in the case a student undertakes 8 Units for both PC3288Q/R and PC3289Q/R.
